newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to sell 21 to 23 bln Ffr of BTANs Thursday.
newsitem.headline: France to sell 21 to 23 bln Ffr of BTANs Thursday.

text.p: France is to offer between 21 and 23 billion francs of government bonds (BTANs) at its next scheduled auction on March 20, the Treasury said on Tuesday.
The Treasury will offer the current two- and five-year benchmark BTANs, the 4.75 percent 1999 and 2002 notes.
The payment date for both bonds will be April 14, the Treasury said in a statement.
